{{Top|leg}}
'''Deathsnakes''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]]'s use of a unique extendible stun staff to quickly strike and disarm an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] was compared to striking like a [[Steel/Legends|steel]] deathsnake while he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]].<ref name="Ooak">''{{JournalCite|5|One of a Kind (short story)}}''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Deathsnakes were first mentioned in the short story [[One of a Kind (short story)|''One of a kind'']] which was written by [[Paul Danner]] and originally published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|5]] in [[1995]], later being released as a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article in [[2004]].
